The five modules in `source/packages` and `painted-materials-bbe33709.png` are
unchanged copies of the previously reviewed Nautilus original building/roof
sources at `2502646482218524fd5129641da769bb82462e4d`. Exact hashes are in
`provenance.json`. This map adapter does not register an engine asset or change
the game's engine pin. The original retained source record is under
`maps/mount-dora/art/source/nautilus/NOTICE.md` in the repository.

Building outlines and landmark locations derive from the retained map data
© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0; see
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright and `maps/mount-dora/source/NOTICE.txt`.
City and property-owner references inform approximate palettes and typologies.
No source photographs or Google imagery are included as textures.
